How it works

Simple, on WhatsApp

No complicated forms or accounts. Everything happens on WhatsApp — you send, I edit, you approve.

1

Send footage

Send your raw videos/photos on WhatsApp with one reference video you like. I confirm price and delivery time first.

2

Edit & preview

I edit and send a preview. University hours are 2–7pm, so editing happens before 2pm and after 7pm — I’ll tell you the exact day.

3

Revisions & delivery

Tell me any changes on the preview, I fix them and send the final HD file — ready to post on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube.
